metadata.venue: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri

ai_summary.key_headline: Algeria's Redemption Bid Meets Austria's Rangnick Revolution

austria: Christoph Baumgartner (muscle injury to his right thigh - Out)

tactical_insights: Riyad Mahrez's creativity will test David Alaba and Austria's organized defense.
This final group match carries historical weight for Algeria, seeking knockout qualification and Gijón redemption.
Ralf Rangnick's high-intensity pressing will challenge Vladimir Petkovic's tactical setup and build-up play.
